headline: BWF Expands Investment in Next Generation Pregnancy Initiative - Burroughs Wellcome Fund
summary: The 2026–2027 Next Generation Pregnancy Initiative offers $700,000 per award over four years. Proposals are due November 17, 2026 at 3 p.m. Eastern, with eligibility checks encouraged by November 3; awards are expected to begin October 1, 2027.
action_hint: Consult the program requirements and ProposalCentral application route.

headline: BWF Announces 2026 Career Awards at the Scientific Interface Recipients - Burroughs Wellcome Fund
summary: BWF selected twelve researchers for its 2026 Career Awards at the Scientific Interface. The announcement describes five-year support for the transition from quantitative postdoctoral research to independent biological-science careers, without a dollar amount.

headline: BWF Announces 2026 Career Awards for Medical Scientists Recipients - Burroughs Wellcome Fund
summary: BWF announces its 2026 Career Awards for Medical Scientists cohort and five years of support for physician-scientists transitioning toward independent faculty positions. This recipient announcement does not state an award amount or open a new application cycle.

headline: Beckman Foundation Commits $375,000 to Orange County Science & Engineering Fair
summary: Beckman renews support for the Orange County Science & Engineering Fair with a $375,000 commitment distributed as $75,000 installments over five years. Funding supports the fair, participation, organizational capacity, science education and related awards.

headline: Beckman Foundation Awards FIRST® California Robotics a $25,000 Orange County Community Support Grant
summary: Beckman awards FIRST California Robotics $25,000 for district sponsorship supporting two Orange County events and resources for teams. The article refers to the January 2027 competition season but retains a separate historical January 2026 kickoff reference; it is not an open grant call.

headline: Six Beckman Young Investigators and Five Arnold O. Beckman Postdoctoral Fellows Win Six-Month Bridge Funding Awards to Sustain Research Programs
summary: Beckman awards $638,382 across eleven researchers in its second 2026 bridge-funding round, covering six months. Eligibility is limited to specified recent or current Beckman awardees; possible renewal is conditional and this announcement does not establish a generally open call.

headline: Scialog: Automating Chemical Laboratories Teams Funded
summary: A joint Scialog initiative supports seven teams through fifteen individual awards of $60,000 in direct costs for automated laboratory research. The announcement does not identify Beckman’s share of the joint funding; the per-award amount must not be treated as its total commitment.

headline: Beckman Foundation Awards Irvine Public Schools Foundation a $25,000 Orange County Community Support Grant
summary: Beckman awards Irvine Public Schools Foundation $25,000 to develop and launch an AI literacy program for educators and students. Resources are planned for the 2026–2027 school year, with subsequent evaluation and refinement; the award is separate from other community grants.

headline: The Jane Coffin Childs Fund for Medical Research Names its 2026 Fellows - Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund
summary: The Jane Coffin Childs Fund selected thirty-two postdoctoral fellows for its 2026 cohort. The fund and partners jointly commit nearly $9 million for three years of stipends; this approximate joint amount is not encoded as an exact fund-only commitment.
